messages.subject: Send html mail with img
parts:
HI! I'm trying to send html mail with img. App get image from  fileInput.

sendEmail <- function(mail_message = "Hello"){    
    url <- "https://api.mailgun.net/v3/sandbox0ebdb5bxxxxxxxxxx802224.mailgun.org/messages"
    api_key <- "key-bdf9f5365xxxxxxxxxxx0f986bc44"
    the_body <-
        list(
            from="Mailgun Sandbox <postm...@sandbox0ebdbxxxxxxxxxxxxxx93d2a802224.mailgun.org>",
            to = "alex...@xxx.de",
            subject="Mailgun from R",
            #text=mail_message,
            html = mail_message
        )    
    req <- httr::POST(url,
                      httr::authenticate("api", api_key),
                      encode = "form",
                      body = the_body)
    httr::stop_for_status(req)    
    TRUE    
}

the_body <- paste("<p>Hi Alex</p>", <p>Screen:</p><img src=", paste0("'",  input$Screenshot$datapath, "'"),">" )      # FROM     fileInput( "Screenshot",   label = NULL, multiple = F,)  

Local it's working ok, bat in shinyapps I have in mail icon instead of image. I suspect, it is wrong src for img.
Which is right?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Send html mail with img
parts: You likely need to embed the image in the e-mail you send and reference it inline. Or the image needs to be located within your Shiny app and served as any other image, e.g. the www sub-directory, and then referenced with a full URL.
